up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows from the ChEMBL database meeting the following criteria: the target is the human single-protein Tyrosyl-DNA phosphodiesterase 2 represented by ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2169736 (target_dictionary.chembl_id='CHEMBL2169736', target_dictionary.target_type='SINGLE PROTEIN', target_dictionary.tax_id=9606 for Homo sapiens). The activity type (standard_type) must be 'IC50', the standard_relation must be '=', and the pchembl_value must not be null. For each qualifying activity, return these columns: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays.chembl_id), target type (from target_dictionary.target_type), tax ID (from target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (from activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (from activities.pchembl_value). Order the results first by molecule ChEMBL ID (ascending) and then by assay ChEMBL ID (ascending). Limit the output to 1000 rows. Do not use DISTINCT; return all qualifying rows up to the limit.
sql:
SELECT 
  assays.chembl_id AS "assay ChEMBL ID",
  target_dictionary.target_type AS "target type",
  target_dictionary.tax_id AS tax_id,
  compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS "canonical SMILES",
  molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS "molecule ChEMBL ID",
  activities.standard_type AS "standard type",
  activities.pchembl_value AS "pChEMBL value"
FROM activities
JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
JOIN compound_structures ON activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
WHERE 
  target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2169736'
  AND target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606
  AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND activities.standard_relation = '='
  AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY molecule_dictionary.chembl_id ASC, assays.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
